notes.title: Demo Available
notes.content:
Demo content is:

6 hour gameplay demo
4 hero classes


Some of the main features missing in the demo:

Music and sound
Menu art
Hero creator
Level up system
Advanced cosmetic options
Proper story presentation
Unlock/Progression system
Boss action card deck
Dungeon master - random events deck
Player versus mode


The main reason I released an early demo; is to see if it generates some interest and a bump in the wishlistings - this will determine if there will be any further development on the game.

I appreciate any feedback on your gameplay experience.

notes.title: Beta Update - randomized levels
notes.content:
*New hero: the recruit
*New monster: dark priest
*Units Tags added to editor, Killing all tagged units will end the game
*The layout of the Nagaboss level is randomized, you can use RoomFlags in the editor for the same result

notes.title: Beta Update - Potions
notes.content:
-Health and stamina potions, in a quick-belt display at the bottom of the screen.
-Heroes and enemies can walk through eachother.
-The ai pathfinding is fixed and they make a nice que if their path is blocked.
-Improved the value change text that is animated above the heroes heads.

notes.title: Beta Update - group attacks, doom track
notes.content:
These updates are ment to communicate with the beta testers. I will not take in more testers at the moment, but will open up to more during development.

https://i.imgur.com/bRFQaS7.jpg

-Network is broken in this version, its mostly a demo of the attack system
-The heroes has 3 new strategies to choose from, some strategies use resourses
-Group attacks, special attacks that targets several opponents
-It now has a victory/gameover state
-Hero death restart added
-Added the doom bar, will count down to failure
-Fixed Ai pathfinding, they still get a bit weird when they block eachothers path
-The board has new textures and 3d walls",
-Strategy select UI upgrade
-Attack UI upgrade
